I find this interesting.
What would happen if a person under the effect of this SCP played a video game?
Would their character gain a new death animation if it didn't have an animation for dying of asphyxiation? Would it alter the code of the game?
It would also be interesting to know what the shortest sentence would be that can be affected by this. "I exist." maybe?
"I exist choking and dying."

If this works with paintings, then you could also test it with abstract art where it's really vague whether or not it's depicting a human. Would it depend on the person affected by this SCP or is it not subjective?
